paragraphs.text: A Planeswalker's Guide to Alara is the first installment in the Planeswalker's Guide series. It was published September 2, 2008.
A Planeswalker's Guide to Alara is written by Doug Beyer and Jenna Helland . It was published on September 2, 2008. This was the only Planeswalker's Guide that was published as a real book.
The guide is written in an in-universe style. While its content is canon, the book itself does not exist in the Multiverse.
